summary: Arbitration petition for appointment of arbitrator under Section 11(6) of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996; Limitation Act applicability determined; limitation bar analyzed for claims; jurisdiction vs admissibility examined; cause of action accrual timing assessed; arbitration commencement criteria established; franchise agreement dispute involving royalty payments and license terms; non-exclusive license for AELA, ACE, AHNA training centers; payment defaults and force majeure issues considered; Section 11(6) petition allowed.
final_judgment: Petition under Section 11(6) allowed; arbitrator to be appointed for dispute adjudication.
